items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: you know who came to our Hot Feet Club? Boston Blackie made at least two visits a week

ctx.x: And we were then splitting the money -- the money had to go eight -- 16 ways, and I was coming home with $10.00 and $15.00 a night, but you know who came to our Hot Feet Club? Boston Blackie made at least two visits a week -- the original Boston Blackie. He was -- had the most handsome teeth of anybody I've ever seen. And he always grinned. He'd paste $1,000.00 bills on each one of the waiter's heads and let them run around all night with $1,000.00 pasted on his
forehead, you know. He'd collect them up before he left.
